selectionPolicy: Mojang release type, Java and obfuscation come from version JSON; pack formats come from version.json inside the official server JAR.
Fabric loader/API/template values come from the exact official example-mod branch; floating Loom is overridden with plan-pinned 1.20.0-alpha.19.
NeoForge loader/Parchment/plugin/Gradle values come from immutable official MDK revisions; the 1.21.1 baseline uses plan-pinned e93d7f09d4eec12c76d1d7be9bf4eaad0246e9e0.
Forge uses recommended promotion when present, otherwise latest; exact-version MDK is mandatory. ForgeGradle ranges are resolved to 6.0.54 or 7.0.40 from official metadata.
Quilt uses the exact per-game Meta profile loader, latest exact Quilt Mappings build for 1.21.x, no mappings on 26.x, and the immutable generic official template with explicit overrides.
Candidate eligibility is artifact availability only. It is not a compatibility, build, runtime, or support claim.

statusSemantics.candidate_eligible: All selected exact upstream artifacts, immutable template input, Java/pack identity, Gradle distribution checksum and plugin coordinates exist. No build or runtime qualification has run.
statusSemantics.supported: Requires separate clean build/server/client/GameTest/visual evidence; zero cells are supported by this discovery.
statusSemantics.unsupported: Exact upstream loader/MDK combination is absent; no nearby-version substitution.
statusSemantics.rejected: Qualification executed and failed; exact failure evidence is preserved with no supported or candidate claim.
statusSemantics.partial: At least one exact build or runtime capability passed; remaining required checks prevent supported status.
